stem: A grower uses a fixed amber-trichome percentage as a universal harvest rule for every cultivar. What is the strongest scientific concern?
choices: Trichome development and maturation vary with genotype, plant age, and sampling position, so a universal single threshold may not generalize
Amber trichomes never occur during maturation
Cultivar differences cannot affect maturity patterns
Representative sampling is unnecessary if a percentage threshold is used
rationale: Research shows genotype and plant age influence glandular-trichome development and maturation. A single universal color threshold can oversimplify those differences.
